final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT sf.transref AS c1, tr.ordertypedist AS c2, AVG(sf.instownpct) AS c3 FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = sf.transref GROUP BY sf.transref, tr.ordertypedist), s2 AS (SELECT c2 AS d1, AVG(c3) AS d2 FROM s1 GROUP BY c2), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS e1, s1.c2 AS e2, s1.c3 AS e3, s1.c3 / s2.d2 AS e4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.d1 = s1.c2), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(e3) AS f1 FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.e1, s3.e2, s3.e3, s3.e4, s3.e3 - s4.f1 AS e5 FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.f1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.e3 > s4.f1) SELECT AVG(e3) AS avg_third, AVG(e4) AS avg_fourth, AVG(e5) AS avg_fifth FROM s5
